description: P-47D on a plinth on the Praça do Expedicionário in front of the museum since 1969 (the 'Praça do Avião'), painted in 1st Fighter Group markings 'A4'; sources disagree on its identity (45-49485 per Pass 2 notes, '4171' per the 2026 compilation, '226756' per ABRAPAC), so the tail is left blank.
